search.job_statement: Prepare your product launch across Product Hunt and startup directories
search.display_title: Product launch prep for Product Hunt and directories
search.seo_title: Product Launch Prep Routine for Product Hunt & Directories
search.meta_description: Research launch sites, prepare the profiles you approve and get a launch plan and draft for each one. Nothing is published without you.

answer: Planning a launch across Product Hunt and startup directories? This routine checks each site's rules, costs and requirements, prepares the accounts and profiles you allow, and writes a site-by-site launch plan with draft copy. You review everything: it never posts, votes or submits a launch for you.

for_whom.why: One plan for every launch site instead of ten browser tabs.
Requirements, assets and timing per site before launch week.

use_cases: You're launching next month and need every site's rules and costs in one place.
You want draft listings ready before launch day without anything going live.

time_and_effort.you_prepare: A list of sites and your approved product facts.

results.name: Launch readiness report
results.description: A written summary of every site, what's ready and what still needs you.

results.name: Site-by-site launch plans
results.description: Positioning, required fields, timing and draft copy for each site.

results.name: Site status list
results.description: Each site marked prepared, research only, blocked or not eligible.

how_it_works: Reads each site's official rules, costs and requirements.
Prepares accounts and profiles only where you allowed it.
Writes a launch plan and draft for each site.
Gives you one report with what's ready and what needs you.

you_provide.label: Your launch sites
you_provide.description: Up to 10 sites you want to launch on.

you_provide.label: Approved product facts
you_provide.description: Your product name, description, links and the claims you allow.

you_provide.label: Account permissions
you_provide.description: Which sites may get accounts. Default: none, research only.

stays_in_your_control: Never posts, votes, messages or submits a launch.
Stops at CAPTCHAs, email verification and billing.
Passwords go only to your secure store.

faq.question: Does it create accounts for me?
faq.answer: Only on sites you allow, and never past a CAPTCHA or a payment step.

faq.question: Can I use my own list of sites?
Does it publish anything?
faq.answer: No. You submit each launch yourself.
